name: Garlic Butter Chicken
description: Crisp-skinned chicken thighs finished in garlic butter.
steps: Pat the chicken dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Sear skin-side down in a hot pan for 8–10 minutes until crisp, then flip.
Cook another 10 minutes until cooked through.
Lower the heat, add the butter and minced garlic, and baste the chicken for 2 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the pan butter.
